info.title: RosteredAI Agency Partner API
info.description:
The integration API for staffing agencies connected to RosteredAI. Receive shift requests, put
candidates forward, manage your workers, skills and compliance, and stay in sync through signed
webhooks.

## Authentication
OAuth 2.0 **client credentials**. Call `POST /agency/apis/token` (form-encoded) to exchange your
`client_id` / `client_secret` for a bearer token, then send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every
other call. Use the **Authorize** button above to try calls in this page.

## Conventions
- Every endpoint is **POST**; reads carry filters in the JSON body.
- All responses (except the token endpoint) use the envelope `{ "data": …, "message": "…" }`.
- All bodies are **camelCase JSON**. Ids are GUIDs; dates are ISO-8601 UTC; times of day are `HH:mm`.
- Your agency is determined by your token — you never send your own `tblAgencyId`.
- Paging: `page`, `pageSize`, `search`, `sortBy`, `order`; responses wrap rows as `{ items, totalRecords, totalPages, page, pageSize }`.

## Status codes
Every operation can return the same set, and the message text is always in `message`:

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | Success. |
| `400` | The request body was missing or failed validation. |
| `401` | The bearer token is missing, malformed or expired. |
| `403` | Your token lacks the required scope, or (for shift requests / placements) the required active webhook subscription. |
| `404` | The item does not exist, or is not yours — another agency’s data reads as not found. |
| `409` | Blocked by a dependency, or the record changed since you read it (row-version clash). |
| `500` | Unexpected server error; `message` carries a reference id to quote to support. |

The token endpoint is the exception: it follows OAuth 2.0 and returns `{ error, error_description }` with `400` (bad request) or `401` (invalid client).

## Isolation
You only ever see your own agency’s data and what connected clients share with you. Another agency’s
id has no effect — every call is scoped to your own agency by your token.

## Webhooks
Reading shift requests / placements also needs an active webhook subscription to
`shift.request.received` / `shift.candidate.accepted`. The ten event payloads we send you are documented
as **callbacks** on *Register or update a webhook endpoint* (under Webhook management).

### Webhook security
Every delivery is signed. Header `X-RosteredAI-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex>`, where
`hex = HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<unix>." + rawBody)` in lowercase. Verify over the **raw** request body,
deduplicate on `eventId`, treat events as unordered, and return `2xx`. A non-2xx response (other than
`410 Gone`) is retried on a backoff schedule before the delivery is dead-lettered; you can replay a
delivery from the delivery history.

> Replace the server `host` variable with the production (or sandbox) address your RosteredAI contact provides.

OAuth2ClientCredentials.description: Client-credentials flow. In Authorize, enter your client_id and client_secret and tick the scopes your credential is granted.

scopes.profile.read: Read your business details, rate cards, coverage zones, skills
scopes.profile.write: Update business details, rate cards, coverage zones, skills
scopes.candidates.read: Read your workers, their skills & qualifications, the catalogue
scopes.candidates.write: Add/update/delete workers, qualifications and catalogue entries
scopes.shifts.read: Read shift requests sent to you (also needs a subscription)
scopes.shifts.write: Respond, submit candidates, accept, decline, withdraw
scopes.placements.read: Read workers a client accepted (also needs a subscription)
scopes.webhooks.write: Register/update endpoints, send tests, replay deliveries

Envelope.description: Standard response envelope used by every operation except the token endpoint.

data.description: Endpoint payload; null on error, or a blocking-dependency list on 409.

error_description.example: The client id or client secret is incorrect.

Unauthenticated.description: Missing, malformed or expired bearer token.

Forbidden.description: The token lacks the required scope, or (for shift requests / placements) the required active webhook subscription.

example.message: Your token does not have the required scope or subscription for this operation.

NotFound.description: The item does not exist, or is not yours — another agency’s data reads as not found.

example.message: The requested item could not be found.

Conflict.description: Blocked by a dependency, or the record changed since you read it (row-version clash).

example.message: The operation was blocked by a dependency, or the record changed since you read it.

ServerError.description: Unexpected server error. The message carries a reference id — quote it to support.

example.message: Something went wrong. Please try again, and quote the reference id if it persists.
